name: Shimohira Ayame
source:
Ayame is a digital artist and the former partner of Kamui. On the exterior, she has a calm and collected personality, although she claims to have intense bottled-up emotions. 

[Spoiler]She's naturally drawn to Kamui due to being one of the 1,440 girls chosen for the Ayame Maspro portion of the Shelter Kids Policy. She was raised in the Shelters, and like the other girls, had her memory of the experience wiped afterwards.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Ayame_Shimohira]Wiki[/url]]
